paper.title_en: Bad Metal Behavior and Lifshitz Transition of a Nagaoka Ferromagnet
paper.abstract_en: Using an extension of the fermionic functional renormalization group for systems where strong correlations give rise to projected Hilbert spaces we calculate the phase diagram and the electronic spectral function of the Hubbard model at infinite on-site repulsion. For a square lattice with nearest-neighbor hopping we find that the ground state evolves from a paramagnetic Fermi liquid at low densities via a state with antiferromagnetic stripe order at intermediate densities to an extended Nagaoka ferromagnet at high densities. The single-particle spectral function of the Nagaoka ferromagnet exhibits a flat but rather broad band characteristic for an incoherent non-Fermi liquid. We identify two distinct ferromagnetic regimes separated by a Lifshitz transition.

decision.title_zh: Nagaoka铁磁体的坏金属行为与Lifshitz相变
decision.abstract_zh: 利用费米子泛函重整化群的一种扩展，用于强关联导致投影希尔伯特空间的系统，我们计算了无穷大在位排斥下Hubbard模型的相图和电子谱函数。对于具有最近邻跳跃的方格点阵，我们发现基态从低密度下的顺磁费米液体，经由中等密度下具有反铁磁条状序的态，演化到高密度下扩展的Nagaoka铁磁体。Nagaoka铁磁体的单粒子谱函数呈现出一条平坦但相当宽的带，这是非相干非费米液体的特征。我们识别出由Lifshitz相变分隔的两个不同铁磁区域。
